name: Libertalia
summary: Pirate crew card game where players simultaneously play characters to claim loot over three campaigns.
rules_text: Game is 3 campaigns of 6 looting days plus a rest day. Each player has 30 cards of one color. At start of campaign 1, one player draws 9 random cards and all players take the same 9 into hand; later campaigns each player keeps 3 unplayed cards and draws 6 new common cards. Each day, booty tokens (chests 5, jewels 3, goods 1, maps, cursed -3, sabers, officers) are placed in 6 spaces, N tokens per space where N=player count. Sunrise: all simultaneously choose 1 hand card face down then reveal. Order characters by rank number, tie by influence value in silver mark. Day: in ascending rank order resolve each character's day ability. Dusk: in descending rank order each player takes one remaining booty token from that day's space and resolves dusk ability and saber/officer effects. Character goes to player's den face up. Night: all dens resolve night abilities simultaneously. Rest day: score dens: doubloons + chests*5 + jewels*3 + goods*1 + 12 per set of 3 maps -3 per cursed relic. Add to total track. Discard all characters in dens/graveyard, return booty and doubloons, give each 10 doubloons to start next campaign.
rating_reason: Simultaneous character play pirate game with hidden hands and bluffing
